downstack-under-pressure.roadmap_item: 1 — Pre-register `downstack rate under pressure` BEFORE the next session is recorded
downstack-under-pressure.hypothesis: paired AUC, winner vs loser, of rows cleared per piece over locks whose PRE-lock board carries at least one garbage row, over the verified prefix; one-sided, winner higher
unblinding: CLAUDE.md publishes the UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC for both banked sessions (08-09: 66.0, 08-14: 70.2). That is not the registered estimand — the registered one conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but the two are correlated, so the bank is partially unblinded and the confirmatory test must be reported as such.

2026-08-19 is banked on the same terms and with the same caveat: CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC (73.6) alongside the other six. Again that is not the registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but it is correlated, so this session enters the bank partially unblinded exactly as 08-09 and 08-14 did. Recorded at the time of banking rather than discovered at analysis time.

2026-08-25 is banked on the same terms and with the same caveat: CLAUDE.md's AUC block publishes its UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC (66.4) alongside the other seven. Again that is not the registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but it is correlated, so this session enters the bank partially unblinded exactly as 08-09, 08-14 and 08-19 did. Recorded at the time of banking rather than discovered at analysis time. Four banked sessions now carry an identical caveat; that is a standing property of how this repo publishes, not four separate lapses, and the confirmatory test must report it once.

2026-09-03 is banked, but its unblinding is LARGER than the standing caveat above and must not be reported as the same sentence. The four sessions before it each published one correlated number — the unconditional per-piece DS paired AUC. This session's report makes the correlated quantity its CENTRAL FINDING: hand claim C012 pins garbage-cleared-per-piece for both players over two match windows and states that it crosses over at the m3 break, and the hero, moments, stats and coaching sections all build on that. Its unconditional per-piece DS AUC is 59.8 (raw 62.0), the lowest of the nine. The registered estimand — which conditions on garbage being on the PRE-lock board, over the verified prefix — has still never been computed on this session or on any banked one, so the bank is not spent; but a confirmatory test that quotes the standing one-line caveat would understate what a reader of 2026-09-03's report already knows. If the confirmatory test cannot carry that, drop this session from the bank rather than soften the disclosure.

deviations.what: The estimand is pinned to the CURRENT instrument — runCaseOracle over the post-hoisted-DAS verified prefix — rather than to the instrument that existed at registration. 08-09 and 08-14 stay in the confirmatory bank.
deviations.why: Between registration (2026-08-07) and this pin the verified prefix grew ~31% (hoisted-DAS fix c9f3065, 2026-08-11) and the board source moved to runCaseOracle (a38ccc1, 2026-08-12). board-metrics.ts itself was last touched 2026-08-06 (f5ee923) and still imports the hand-port runCase, so 'as computed today' named an instrument the rest of the repo has demoted. Both changes were made for documented drift reasons, blind to this hypothesis, and the estimand has never been computed on the banked sessions. Estimand, unit, direction, test, threshold and controls are unchanged, so this is a deviation in instrument, not a new hypothesis.
